name: input-router
description: Large MCP results that read as documents (pages, issues, threads) get a heading outline beside them, so Claude's first search lands on a real section. The result itself is never changed, so context-mode still indexes it whole. Opt-in Haiku synthesis per tool. Long PDFs are read by Haiku. /input-router [on|off|status].

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Add MCP outlines and read long PDFs with Haiku. /input-router off turns it off until /input-router on.

outlineMinChars.title: Outline from (characters)
outlineMinChars.description: An MCP result at or over this size that reads as a document gets an outline. 4096 matches context-mode's own trigger, below which it keeps the result as is.

synthesizeTools.title: Haiku synthesis for
synthesizeTools.description: Comma separated MCP tool names or parts of names (for example getConfluenceContent, getJiraIssue), or * for all. A matching result also gets a short Haiku synthesis for your request beside it. Empty turns synthesis off.

pdfPages.title: PDF page limit
pdfPages.description: A Read of a PDF with more pages than this (and no pages argument) is read by Haiku.

maxChunks.title: Most Haiku chunks
maxChunks.description: PDF text is read by Haiku in chunks of about 100,000 characters in parallel. Text past the last chunk is not read, and the notes say how much.

keepDays.title: Keep PDF text (days)
keepDays.description: Extracted PDF text is kept this many days (at least 1) under ~/.claude/mods-logs/input-router/text/ and removed at session start.
